system.flavor: High-pressure 25mm squash-head round for the Arasaka Tsunami launchers. Direct hit; armor halved.
system.notes:
THE BOOK: Solo of Fortune 2 p.12, "HEP: 5d6, (1/2 SP, armor reduced 2 lvls, 1/2 dam. stun), 25eb". Maximum Metal p.77: "HEP 5D6 Special AP (Pen 3*)".

MODEL: armor at half SP (armorMultSoft/Hard 0.5); the armor-reduced-2-levels and half-damage-is-stun clauses are by hand.

MODEL: the round has no blast radius of its own, so blastRadius is 0.5 m - the module's area flow then reaches the target's own square and nothing beyond it (a 0 would fall back to the 5 m grenade row of CP2020 p.99).
system.source: Solo of Fortune 2 p.12; Maximum Metal p.77
